description: This file declares the interface and factory class for MediaKeysCapabilities within the Rialto client media capabilities module. It defines classes, methods, and external dependencies related to media key capabilities handling.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing MediaKeysCapabilities instances, including singleton access and thread safety mechanisms.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilities
classes.description: Implementation of IMediaKeysCapabilities, providing methods to query supported key systems and their versions.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory::getMediaKeysCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton IMediaKeysCapabilities instance.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities::getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a list of supported media key systems.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities::supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities::getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.
